validation:is-true.doc:name: Valid failure type
validation:is-true.message: failureType must be AI_EXTRACTION, ERP_POSTING, DATABASE or UNKNOWN

db:select.doc:name: Open item for invoice?
db:select.db:sql: SELECT queue_id, status, attempt_count FROM recovery_queue WHERE invoice_id = :invoiceId AND failure_type = :failureType AND status IN ('PENDING','IN_PROGRESS')

set-payload.doc:name: Existing item
set-payload.value: #[output application/json --- { queueId: vars.open[0].queue_id, status: vars.open[0].status, alreadyQueued: true }]

db:insert.doc:name: Insert queue item
db:insert.db:sql: INSERT INTO recovery_queue (invoice_id, failure_type, error_code, error_message, attempt_count, max_attempts, next_attempt_at, status, correlation_id) VALUES (:invoiceId, :failureType, :errorCode, :errorMessage, 0, :maxAttempts, DATE_ADD(NOW(), INTERVAL :delaySeconds SECOND), 'PENDING', :correlationId)
db:insert.db:input-parameters: #[{ invoiceId: vars.item.invoiceId, failureType: vars.item.failureType, errorCode: vars.item.errorCode, errorMessage: do { var m = (vars.item.errorMessage default '') as String --- if (sizeOf(m) > 1000) m[0 to 999] else m }, maxAttempts: (vars.item.maxAttempts default 5) as Number, delaySeconds: (vars.item.delaySeconds default 60) as Number, correlationId: correlationId }]

logger.doc:name: Log enqueued
logger.message: #[output application/json indent=false --- { event: 'recovery.enqueued', invoiceId: vars.item.invoiceId, failureType: vars.item.failureType }]

set-payload.doc:name: Created item
set-payload.value: #[output application/json --- { queueId: payload.generatedKeys.GENERATED_KEY default (valuesOf(payload.generatedKeys)[0] default null), status: 'PENDING', alreadyQueued: false }]

set-variable.doc:name: Batch size
set-variable.value: #[do { var l = (attributes.queryParams.limit default '10') as Number --- if (l < 1) 1 else if (l > 50) 50 else l }]

db:select.doc:name: Lock due items
db:select.db:sql: SELECT queue_id, invoice_id, failure_type, error_code, attempt_count, max_attempts, correlation_id FROM recovery_queue WHERE (status = 'PENDING' AND next_attempt_at <= NOW()) OR (status = 'IN_PROGRESS' AND updated_at < DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL 15 MINUTE)) ORDER BY next_attempt_at LIMIT :limit FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED

db:update.doc:name: Mark IN_PROGRESS
db:update.db:sql: UPDATE recovery_queue SET status = 'IN_PROGRESS' WHERE queue_id = :queueId

ee:message.ee:set-payload: %dw 2.0 output application/json --- vars.due map ((r) -> { queueId: r.queue_id, invoiceId: r.invoice_id, failureType: r.failure_type, errorCode: r.error_code, attemptCount: r.attempt_count, maxAttempts: r.max_attempts, originalCorrelationId: r.correlation_id })

validation:is-true.doc:name: Valid status
validation:is-true.message: status must be PENDING, RESOLVED or DEAD

db:update.doc:name: Update queue item
db:update.db:sql: UPDATE recovery_queue SET status = :status, attempt_count = COALESCE(:attemptCount, attempt_count), next_attempt_at = CASE WHEN :delaySeconds IS NULL THEN next_attempt_at ELSE DATE_ADD(NOW(), INTERVAL :delaySeconds SECOND) END, error_code = COALESCE(:errorCode, error_code), error_message = COALESCE(:errorMessage, error_message) WHERE queue_id = :queueId
db:update.db:input-parameters: #[{ queueId: attributes.uriParams.queueId as Number, status: payload.status, attemptCount: payload.attemptCount, delaySeconds: payload.delaySeconds, errorCode: payload.errorCode, errorMessage: payload.errorMessage }]

set-variable.doc:name: 404 override
set-variable.value: #[{ httpStatus: 404, code: 'QUEUE_ITEM_NOT_FOUND', message: 'Recovery queue item not found' }]

set-payload.value: #[output application/json --- { queueId: attributes.uriParams.queueId as Number, status: payload.status }]

db:select.doc:name: Select queue items
db:select.db:sql: SELECT queue_id, invoice_id, failure_type, error_code, error_message, attempt_count, max_attempts, status, DATE_FORMAT(next_attempt_at, '%Y-%m-%d %T') AS next_attempt_at, DATE_FORMAT(created_at, '%Y-%m-%d %T') AS created_at FROM recovery_queue WHERE (:status IS NULL OR status = :status) ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT 200
db:select.db:input-parameters: #[{ status: if (isEmpty(attributes.queryParams.status default '')) null else attributes.queryParams.status }]
